# Patina Design Studio

Patina Design Studio is a Sydney-based interior architecture and design studio specialising in high-end residential projects, including new builds, renovations, off-plan apartments, spatial planning, design consultation, design documentation, curated furnishing and procurement, and design management during construction.

The studio is led by Jacqui Hurwitz, who holds a Bachelor of Interior Architecture from UNSW and has over 15 years of international experience across Australia, London, Russia, Miami, Toronto and China.

Patina Design Studio focuses on calm, refined and functional homes that are deeply considered in relation to spatial planning, materiality, proportion, lighting, detailing, flow and long-term liveability.

## Location

Sydney, New South Wales, Australia.
